notes: Both bracketed assimilated articles are unrepresented, since the ASV writes 'a storm' and 'a cloud' with indefinite articles that belong to their nouns (rules 12, 15).

אוֹתָךְ is tagged To but is read comitatively, as the ASV's written 'with' shows; aligning it there is better than leaving the marker unrepresented and the 'with' added, since rule 16's subtraction test finds that only this particle's relation is lost when the word is dropped.
The 'thou' at t011 realizes תִּהְיֶה's own person and number (rule 17), while t021 is the explicit אַתָּה.
